seo.metaTitle: Mushroom Grow Log Care Instructions - Centrifungal
seo.metaDescription: Step-by-step care instructions for your Centrifungal mushroom grow log. Learn how to water, position, and harvest your mushrooms.

blocks.heading: How to Get the Best From Your Grow Log

blocks.body:
Congratulations on your new grow log! Follow these simple steps to enjoy fresh, home-grown mushrooms.

## Getting Started

1. Remove the grow log from its packaging and soak it in cold water for 24 hours.
2. Place the log in a cool, shaded spot - indoors or outdoors. Avoid direct sunlight.
3. Mist the log daily with water to keep it moist. A spray bottle works perfectly.
4. Expect to see mushrooms appear within 1-3 weeks depending on the species and conditions.
